title: "'Flying Saucer' Seen Over City" - Seattle Post-Intelligencer, October 1952
description: Small newspaper clipping headlined "'Flying Saucer' Seen Over City" from the Seattle Post-Intelligencer, page 3, column 6. It reports a "flying saucer" that hung motionless for nearly five minutes, then streaked away, observed Sunday over South Seattle by several persons, including a former anti-aircraft artillery officer who watched it through binoculars and said it appeared to have four sources of light. The page carries an FBI Seattle stamp dated OCT 6 1952 and file number 100-18945-39.
